rationale: C22 is a highly specific individualized civil-service-status order using the precise machinery indicated by the child's title: conferring competitive civil service status upon a named person through Civil Service Commission authorization. This is materially closer than C15 and C18, which authorize named individuals' appointments to competitive positions without compliance with competitive requirements but do not specifically confer status. The shared individualized personnel-relief structure makes C22 a plausible drafting template despite the child's operative text being unavailable.

shared_material.child_excerpt: conferring competitive civil service status upon William P. Francisco
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Civil Service Commission is hereby authorized to confer a competitive status upon Miss Winifred R. Donnellon ... without regard to the competitive provisions of the Civil Service Rules
shared_material.explanation: Both directives concern Commission-mediated conferral of competitive civil-service status on one named individual, using the same exceptional personnel mechanism.
